import urllib.request
import json

# Check NCBI Gene 55536
url = "https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id=55536&retmode=json"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Python/urllib'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
    res = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    gene_info = res["result"]["55536"]
    print("NCBI Gene Name:", gene_info.get("name"))
    print("NCBI Description:", gene_info.get("description"))
    print("NCBI Other Aliases:", gene_info.get("otheraliases"))
    print("NCBI Other Designations:", gene_info.get("otherdesignations"))
